This IDS series 48VDC 400W servo motor features a built-in servo drive and supports CANopen/RS485/Pulse communication. Its compact, integrated design saves valuable mounting space and eliminates the need for separate encoder connections and motor wiring, significantly reducing setup time. By minimizing electrical interference, it ensures smoother and more reliable operation.

Items in Kit

  • IDS-C60AP-48V400W: IDS Series 400W CANopen/RS485/Pulse Integrated DC Servo Motor
  • IDS400-1.0M-PW: 1.0m power cable
  • IDS400C-1.0M-IO: 1.0m control signal cable
  • IDS400C-1.5M-RJ45: 1.5m communication cable

Key Features

  • Supports Position, Velocity, and Torque Control Modes
  • 24 - 48VDC Input Voltage, with 48VDC as the Typical Input
  • Supports CANopen, Modbus RS485, and Pulse Control
  • Built-in Multi-Position and Multi-Speed Control, with 13 Homing Modes
  • Supports Software-Based Commissioning and Customizable I/O Functions, including Fault Reset, Emergency Stop, Positioning Complete, and more
  • Powered by a Next-Generation 32-bit ARM Platform, delivering excellent cost performance, smooth operation, and superior noise and vibration performance
  • Comprehensive Protection Against Overvoltage, Undervoltage, Overspeed, Overcurrent, Overload, Position Errors, and Stall Conditions, with 2 x Overload Capacity

Servo Motor Specification

  • Part Number: IDS-C60AP-48V400W
  • Pairs of Poles: 5
  • Rated Power: 400W
  • Rated Torque: 1.27Nm(179.85oz.in)
  • Rated Speed: 3000rpm ± 10%
  • Peak Speed: 3600rpm ± 10%
  • Back EMF Constant: 8.3V/K rpm
  • Rated Voltage: 48VDC
  • Rated Current: 10A
  • Resistance: 0.31Ohms
  • Inductance: 0.49mH
  • Interia: 0.52kg·cm²
  • Torque Coefficient: 0.13Nm/A
  • Electrical Time Constant: 1.58ms
  • Protection Level: IP54(motor part only, driver excluded)
  • Insulation Class: Class F
  • Body Length: 108.9mm
  • Shaft Length: 30mm
  • Shaft Diameter: 14mm
